adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the Prisma `booking.update({... attendees.createMany ...})` persists new attendees before the external side-effect `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` is executed, and that calendar update is not wrapped in a try/catch or transaction. If `updateCalendarAttendees` throws, the handler fails after the DB mutation. A retry with the same emails will hit `uniqueGuests.length === 0` because `uniqueGuests` filters out emails already present in `booking.attendees`, causing a `BAD_REQUEST` and preventing recovery while also skipping the email notifications.
